programs.title: Isle of Dogs
programs.desc: The futuristic city of Megasaki in Japan.In the face of a dog flu epidemic, the corrupt Mayor Kobayashi declares a state of emergency and issues a decree under which all dogs are to be quarantined, i.e. sent to an island covered with garbage.The immediate implementation of the order arouses rebellion in twelve-year-old Atari, who thus loses his four-legged friend.However, the boy does not want to give up so easily, he steals a small flying machine and goes to the island to find Ciapek.Once there, he asks for help from a pack of neglected, hungry dogs who are looking for food among the garbage.Together with his new friends, he sets out to find his ward.The film received two Oscar nominations.He was also nominated, among others:to the Golden Globes and BAFTA awards.The animation director is the winner of many awards, for this production he was also honored with the Silver Bear at the Berlinale festival.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: The Inventor
programs.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programs.title: Neuilly-Poissy
programs.desc: Daniel (Max Boublil) is a successful entrepreneur.He successfully combines running a business with a successful family life.However, when financial irregularities are discovered in his company, he is forced to exchange a luxurious apartment in the city of Neuilly for a cell in the prison in Poissy.From one day to the next, he finds himself in a world whose rules he does not understand.Moreover, he is a Jew and now he will be hanging out with Muslims.However, thanks to his sense of humor and the ability to cope with difficult situations, Daniel tries to adapt to the new reality.

programs.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programs.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her fateful fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programs.title: The List
programs.desc: Matt is cheating on his fiancée Abby with a celebrity from the "exceptions to monogamy" list.The hurt woman decides to pay him back in kind.
